title: Oxidation-free nanoscale optomechanical sensor incorporating a triangular truss resonator for crosstalk-free bimodal pressure and temperature sensing
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37660-37672
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04668H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abdullah Taharat, Mohammad Abrar Kabir, Aseer Imad Keats, A. K. M. Rakib, Rakibul Hasan Sagor
A gold-based MIM sensor was developed for accurate detection of pressure and temperature through deformation of a triangular truss resonator and thermo-optic tuning of a PDMS-filled cavity, demonstrating crosstalk-free robust dual-mode operation.
